scope_note: Foundational corrective re-audit for Switch's Tahoe Reno 1 / Citadel project at 1 Superloop Circle in Storey County. The direct-source pass covered the selected IM3 point and operating chronology; Nevada GOED approval and audit tables; Switch SEC filings; Storey County assessor and treasurer accounts, budgets, agendas, infrastructure, planning, building, recorder and fire records; Nevada utility-regulatory and environmental permits; contractor and supplier records; community-recipient records; and BEA and BLS county outcomes. Ten additional observations are retained: nine reported actuals and one source projection. Three current GOED observations supersede three older GOED observations through explicit removal directives; all campus and company-county facts remain unallocated to Tahoe Reno 1. No synthesis fragment is added: four exact fiscal arithmetic or break-even models remain eligible, and thirty legacy models require removal. The single-claim capital-floor restatement is removed because the revised GOED capital observation is already published directly and a duplicate modeled record adds no decision-useful information. Building-level capital, construction payroll and residence, operating payroll, supplier payments, utility meters and bills, realized abatement value, same-scope public costs, net fiscal results and causal county outcomes remain unobserved.

project_updates.title: Boundary, entity and chronology verified
project_updates.notes: IM3 point 06685432442 maps to the Citadel location but provides no footprint or account crosswalk. Switch's 2021 10-K says the first Citadel data center began operating in November 2016; the operator publicly announced the campus open on February 15, 2017. The selected project is Tahoe Reno 1, while the assessor parcel and operator personal-property account cover wider campus assets. Later Tahoe Reno 2 construction, northern APNs, tenant equipment, off-site Citadel Solar and other Switch campuses remain outside the selected boundary unless retained explicitly as unallocated context.
project_updates.project_description: Switch's Citadel is a multi-building data-center campus at 1 Superloop Circle in Storey County, Nevada; Tahoe Reno 1 opened on February 15, 2017. The project account separates the first building from campus-wide capital work, Switch company-county tax and employment records, the core real-property parcel, tenant equipment, and later expansion phases.

project_updates.title: GOED audit revision and incentive chronology reconciled
project_updates.notes: The 2025 GOED report preserves the $1.386677024 billion approval commitment, 50-job commitment, $28.98 contract wage and projected $75,720,025 sales/use-tax plus $32,095,728 personal-property abatements as forecasts. Its audit table supersedes legacy claims clm_study_switch_storey_audit_jobs_2020 (111), clm_study_switch_storey_audit_wage_2020 ($50.97) and clm_study_switch_storey_audit_capex_2020 ($179,943,184) with clm_study_switch_storey_audit_jobs_2020_rev2025 (324), clm_study_switch_storey_audit_wage_2020_rev2025 ($50.97) and clm_study_switch_storey_audit_capex_2020_rev2025 ($452,372,959). ORCHESTRATOR REMOVAL DIRECTIVE: remove the three legacy claims when reconciling the append-only base. The identical results on Storey, Clark and another Switch row are not summed; none is a Tahoe Reno 1 allocation, payroll or realized incentive ledger.

project_updates.title: Assessor and treasurer accounts extended through current returned year
project_updates.notes: Live County assessor and treasurer searches opened Switch account CM001611 for tax years 2016-2027 and parcel 005-012-23 for available real-property years. Three 2027 personal-property stocks are added; the displayed 0.0000 rate and absent bill are not interpreted as a tax exemption or zero liability. Taxing-body lines are bill allocations, not recipient cash receipts; the portal lists 63 tenant equipment accounts at the parcel, all excluded. No 2027 real-property assessment, current personal-property bill, recipient receipt ledger, abatement counterfactual or Tahoe Reno 1 allocation was available.

project_updates.title: SEC capital-expenditure series completed without building allocation
project_updates.notes: Switch's Q1-Q4 2021 filings report Citadel campus capital flows of $59.6 million, $59.4 million, $48.2 million and $37.8 million. Q1 and Q2 mix shared systems, new sectors and Tahoe Reno 2 site work; Q3 mixes a Tahoe Reno 1 tenant sector with shared systems and Tahoe Reno 2; Q4 is primarily Tahoe Reno 2. The four quarters stay separate direct observations and are not added to the 2020 GOED audit, used as construction labor or supplier spend, or allocated by floor area. The 2021 10-K is portfolio-level outside its facility description and yields no Tahoe Reno 1 depreciation, revenue, operating expense, payroll or asset ledger.

project_updates.notes: Storey County building, planning, Agenda Center and development pages were searched for Switch, Citadel, Tahoe Reno 1, Superloop, APN 005-012-23, permit, valuation, fee, inspection and certificate of occupancy across 2015-2026. The public building page exposes forms but no historical case ledger. SUP 2024-007 concerns later northern parcels and is excluded. No original building-permit number, administrative valuation, impact or connection fee, inspection result, certificate date or Tahoe Reno 1 crosswalk was found; those source records require County retrieval.

project_updates.title: Electric, water and wastewater audit finds capacity but no meter
project_updates.notes: Nevada utility-regulatory dockets, Switch SEC filings, TRI-GID and NDEP water records were searched for load, meter, bill, tariff, interconnection, reclaimed-water delivery, discharge and customer contribution. The public materials describe 130 MW available at Tahoe Reno 1 full build-out, a regional effluent pipeline, maximum campus cooling demand and a zero-discharge permit. These are design, permit or contractual capacities rather than measured electricity, water, wastewater, cost or environmental impact. No project meter, kWh, peak demand, utility bill or payment, interconnection cost, actual water volume or Tahoe Reno 1 allocation was found.

project_updates.title: Environmental and generator audit retains no modeled operations
project_updates.notes: NDEP air permits, director reviews, water-pollution-control materials and federal facility access were searched by Switch, Citadel, 1 Superloop Circle, Facility A1896 and permit numbers. Facility-wide potential-to-emit limits and equipment authorizations are regulatory ceilings, not actual emissions, fuel, generator runtime, outage response, damages or Tahoe Reno 1 quantities. The permit history confirms site development by 2015 but not building completion. Inspection reports, annual emissions, test results, fuel logs and building-equipment crosswalks remain unresolved.

project_updates.title: Budgets, infrastructure, bonds and public costs remain unreconciled
project_updates.notes: County budgets, ACFR-style financial materials, Board packets, TRI infrastructure and tax-increment records were searched for Switch, Citadel, effluent pipeline, special assessment, TIF, bond, capital project, reimbursement, fire, road and public-service cost. The regional pipeline and TIA involve Switch with Google, Tesla and Reno Land; approximately $500,000 of FY2022 increment is joint Google/Switch context and cannot be divided. No Switch-only assessment paid, reimbursement, bond proceeds, marginal fire/road/service expense, Tahoe Reno 1 infrastructure share or same-scope net fiscal ledger was found. Company payments, public expenditure, tax allocations and financing cannot be netted across different scopes and periods.

project_updates.title: Construction, contractor, supplier and workforce search closes identities only
project_updates.notes: OSHA, GOED, Nevada workforce material, operator filings and contractor searches used Switch, Tahoe Reno 1, Citadel, Superloop, Martin-Harris, construction, subcontractor, supplier, invoice, payroll, local hire and resident. OSHA confirms Martin-Harris at the site in November 2016; GOED supplies company-county job and wage snapshots. No complete contractor roster, contract or payment, worker hours, job-years, construction payroll, occupation mix, residence, operating FTE status, benefits, supplier geography or local purchasing share was found. Generic Prince William or national construction coefficients cannot repair those gaps.

project_updates.title: Community and recipient audit separates commitments from realized gifts
project_updates.notes: Community and recipient searches reconciled Storey Fire District minutes, County records, Switch materials, University of Nevada reporting and named-recipient results. UNR's greater-than-$3.4-million five-year infrastructure-services announcement is retained as a projection, not cash or completed support. The March 2025 $355,271 approved quick-attack reimbursement and April rounded $356,000 reported donation describe the same transaction and are not added; the legacy $356,000 actual remains controlling. The later greater-than-$2-million ladder-truck contribution remains a separate lower-bound actual and the district's $100,000 equipment plan remains a public-cost projection. No recipient ledger, service-delivery valuation, Tahoe Reno 1 allocation or proof that these amounts are exhaustive was found.

project_updates.title: Corporate, recorder, financing and legal search yields no project cash flow
project_updates.notes: SEC entity and finance filings, the County recorder index, assessor sales history and public searches for Switch LTD, NV RNO 1 LLC, 1 Superloop Circle, parcel 005-012-23, deed, lien, UCC, lease, bond, judgment and litigation were reviewed. The public index exposed deed-chain identifiers and zero displayed consideration but no verified project acquisition price, construction loan, municipal debt, lease payment, lien amount, settlement or Tahoe Reno 1 financial statement. Portfolio revenue, debt, acquisition and property values are not allocated to this project.

project_updates.title: Employment and wage outcome models fail causal and identity gates
project_updates.notes: BLS QCEW and repository county panels provide Storey County covered employment and wage context but cannot identify Switch employees, contractors, residents or Tahoe Reno 1. The campus opened amid simultaneous Tahoe-Reno Industrial Center growth, including Tesla and later Google development; no comparison county, parallel-trend diagnostic, stable treatment share or single building treatment date was established. Legacy employment-comparison and wage-comparison gaps therefore require removal: they are descriptive arithmetic presented as project-linked outcomes and do not support causal attribution.

project_updates.title: GDP outcome model fails causal and allocation gates
project_updates.notes: BEA supplies county GDP context, not a Tahoe Reno 1 outcome. Staggered Citadel construction, later facilities and concurrent industrial-center investments prevent a defensible intervention and counterfactual; no sector-specific treatment share, comparison county or pre-trend test isolates this building. The legacy GDP comparison gap requires removal rather than being described as a project effect.
